Join ASML as a Material Handler. Are you looking for a logistics role within one of the world's most innovative high-tech companies? Do you enjoy working in a dynamic warehouse environment where precision, teamwork, and efficiency are essential? For ASML in Veldhoven, we are looking for multiple Material Handlers to join the Receiving & Picking department. In this position, you will play a vital role in the logistics process by ensuring that incoming materials are received, inspected, processed, and distributed accurately and on time. As a Material Handler, you will help keep operations running smoothly by making sure the right materials are available when and where they are needed. Your contribution will directly support ASML's advanced manufacturing activities and the production of some of the most sophisticated technology in the world. If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to work in a fast-paced high-tech environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. Wie zoeken we? We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced high-tech logistics environment. You have a strong focus on quality, work well both independently and as part of a team, and are committed to delivering excellent results every day. MBO Level 3 or 4 education, preferably in Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field Experience in a logistics, warehouse, manufacturing, or operational environment EPT certificate or other MHE skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills Basic computer and administrative skills Good command of the English language, both written and spoken Working hours: 06:30–15:30 and 15:00–00:00 Wat bieden wij je? We offer an exciting opportunity to grow within a leading high-tech environment, with great working conditions and a role where your contribution truly matters: A gross monthly salary of €3.195 (excluding shift allowance) 25.1% shift allowance for all hours worked Travel reimbursement 13th month salary

Annual bonus based upon company result 27 days of paid annual leave Long-term career and development opportunities Functieomschrijving As a Material Handler, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth flow of materials throughout ASML's logistics operation. Working within the Receiving & Picking department, you will help keep warehouse processes running efficiently while supporting the delivery of high-quality products and services. What You'll Be Doing: Receive, inspect, and process incoming materials and products Pick and prepare materials for internal customers and production teams Ensure materials are handled and routed correctly within assigned logistics processes Perform quality checks to verify accuracy and compliance with operational standards Identify and address minor operational issues to maintain workflow efficiency Report deviations and escalate more complex issues when required Maintain accurate records and update information in logistics systems Follow established procedures, work instructions, and safety guidelines Contribute to the continuity and performance of daily warehouse operations In this position, you will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on one of the world's most advanced high-tech supply chains while developing your logistics expertise in a dynamic and innovative environment.
